# Design (ADEMP)

* **Aims**: to compare Models 2, 3, and 4 for estimating the population change-point (the mean of the participant-specific change-points, which corresponds to the EAR) when change-points do or do not vary among participants, and to evaluate Model 4 for the SD of the change-points and for participant-specific change-points.
* **Data-generating mechanisms**: y = plateau + u0 + (slope + u1) × min(x − cp_i, 0) + e, with cp_i = 0.9 + u3; plateau 1.3, slope −0.8, SD(u0) = SD(u1) = SD(e) = 0.15 (based on the fits to the four datasets); protein intakes 0.1, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2, 1.5, and 1.8 g/kg/day. Factors: SD of change-points (0, 0.1, 0.2 g/kg/day) × number of participants (8, 16) × intake levels per participant (all 7, or 4 selected at random) = 12 scenarios; 500 replicates each.
* **Estimands**: population change-point (0.9 g/kg/day), SD of the change-points, participant-specific change-points.
* **Methods**: as in the analysis of the published data. Models 2 and 3: REML profile over candidate change-points from 0 to 2.5 g/kg/day by 0.01, with the AIC-based 95% interval. Model 4: population change-point bounded to (0, 2.5) g/kg/day with a Normal(0, 1) prior on the logit scale; half-normal(0, 0.3) (primary) and half-normal(0, 1) priors for the SD of the change-points; 4 chains of 2000 iterations including 1000 warm-up iterations; point estimates are posterior medians and intervals are 95% equal-tailed credible intervals. Random change-point model of Tang et al. (2014) (only the change-point varies among participants): maximum likelihood with the exact likelihood (Tang (ML)) and with the first-order approximation (Tang (FO)), Wald 95% CI with t quantile (df = participants − 1), change-point restricted to (0, 2.5).
* **Performance measures**: bias, empirical SE, RMSE, and coverage and width of the 95% intervals, with Monte Carlo SEs.

```{r}
#| output: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(gt)
  library(patchwork)
})
source("simulation/sim_functions.R", echo = FALSE)  # for `scenarios` and `truth`

results_dir <- "simulation/results"
files <- list.files(results_dir, pattern = "^scenario_.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
raw <- map(files, read_rds)
stopifnot(all(map_chr(raw, ~ .x$models23_grid %||% "") == "0-2.5"), all(map_lgl(raw, ~ isTRUE(.x$tang_added))),
          all(map_chr(raw, ~ .x$model4_point %||% "") == "median"))

flatten_results <- function(x, what) {
  map_dfr(x$results, function(r) {
    if (!is.null(r$error)) return(NULL)
    r[[what]] |> mutate(rep = r$rep)
  }) |>
    mutate(scenario = x$scenario$scenario)
}

# Models 2 and 3: a limit is missing when the AIC does not exceed its minimum by 4 within the
# range of candidate change-points; the interval then extends to the end of the range (0 or 2.5),
# as the credible interval of Model 4 is confined to the same range.
cp_range <- c(0, 2.5)
pop <- map_dfr(raw, flatten_results, what = "pop") |>
  distinct(scenario, rep, method, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  left_join(scenarios, by = "scenario") |>
  mutate(
    m23 = method %in% c("Model 2", "Model 3"),
    open_limit = m23 & !is.na(est) & (is.na(lower) | is.na(upper)),
    lower = if_else(m23 & !is.na(est) & is.na(lower), cp_range[1], lower),
    upper = if_else(m23 & !is.na(est) & is.na(upper), cp_range[2], upper),
    no_interval = is.na(lower) | is.na(upper),
    covered = !no_interval & lower <= truth$cp & upper >= truth$cp
  )
ind <- map_dfr(raw, flatten_results, what = "ind") |>
  distinct(scenario, rep, method, id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  left_join(scenarios, by = "scenario")
n_errors <- sum(map_int(raw, ~ sum(map_lgl(.x$results, function(r) !is.null(r$error)))))

scen_lab <- function(n, l) factor(sprintf("n = %d, %s", n, ifelse(l == 7, "7 levels", "4 of 7 levels")),
                                  levels = c("n = 8, 7 levels", "n = 8, 4 of 7 levels",
                                             "n = 16, 7 levels", "n = 16, 4 of 7 levels"))
method_colors <- c("Model 2" = "#4269d0", "Model 3" = "#6cc5b0",
                   "Model 4 (HN 0.3)" = "#ff725c", "Model 4 (HN 1)" = "#a0522d",
                   "Tang (ML)" = "#9b59b6", "Tang (FO)" = "#d4a017")
method_levels <- names(method_colors)
dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

Replicates per scenario and method: `r pop |> count(scenario, method) |> pull(n) |> range() |> paste(collapse = "–")`; replicates with errors: `r n_errors`.

# Population change-point

```{r}
perf_pop <- pop |>
  group_by(scenario, sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method) |>
  summarise(
    n_rep = n(),
    n_est = sum(!is.na(est)),
    no_estimate = mean(is.na(est)),
    bias = mean(est - truth$cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    emp_se = sd(est, na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse = sqrt(mean((est - truth$cp)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    coverage = mean(covered),
    width = mean(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    open_limit = mean(open_limit),
    no_interval = mean(no_interval),
    divergent_any = mean(n_divergent > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    rhat_gt_1.01 = mean(max_rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    secs = mean(secs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(mcse_bias = emp_se / sqrt(n_est),
         mcse_coverage = sqrt(coverage * (1 - coverage) / n_rep),
         across(c(divergent_any, rhat_gt_1.01), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
write_csv(perf_pop, "output/simulation_population.csv")

# Model 4 excluding replicates with divergent transitions or R-hat > 1.01 (sensitivity check)
perf_conv <- pop |>
  filter(str_detect(method, "Model 4"), n_divergent == 0, max_rhat <= 1.01) |>
  group_by(scenario, sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method) |>
  summarise(n_rep = n(), bias = mean(est - truth$cp), coverage = mean(covered), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(perf_conv, "output/simulation_population_converged.csv")

# Table 3 of the manuscript (primary prior for Model 4)
table3 <- perf_pop |>
  filter(method %in% c("Model 2", "Model 3", "Model 4 (HN 0.3)")) |>
  mutate(method = recode(method, "Model 4 (HN 0.3)" = "Model 4")) |>
  select(sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method, bias, rmse, coverage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = c(bias, rmse, coverage), names_glue = "{method}_{.value}") |>
  arrange(sd_cp, n, desc(levels_per_participant))
write_csv(table3, "output/table3_simulation.csv")

# Model 4 vs the random change-point model of Tang et al. (2014)
table_tang <- perf_pop |>
  filter(method %in% c("Model 4 (HN 0.3)", "Tang (ML)", "Tang (FO)")) |>
  select(sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method, bias, rmse, coverage, width) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = c(bias, rmse, coverage, width), names_glue = "{method}_{.value}") |>
  arrange(sd_cp, n, desc(levels_per_participant))
write_csv(table_tang, "output/table_simulation_tang.csv")

perf_pop |>
  mutate(design = scen_lab(n, levels_per_participant)) |>
  select(sd_cp, design, method, n_est, no_estimate, bias, mcse_bias, emp_se, rmse, coverage, mcse_coverage,
         width, open_limit, divergent_any, rhat_gt_1.01) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "design") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(bias, mcse_bias, emp_se, rmse, width), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = c(no_estimate, coverage, mcse_coverage, open_limit, divergent_any, rhat_gt_1.01), decimals = 1)
```

For Models 2 and 3, `open_limit` is the proportion of replicates in which a limit of the interval was set to the end of the range of candidate change-points, and `no_estimate` is the proportion in which the model could not be fitted at any candidate change-point; these replicates are counted as not covering.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 6
fig_pop <- perf_pop |>
  mutate(design = scen_lab(n, levels_per_participant),
         se_bias = mcse_bias, se_cov = mcse_coverage) |>
  pivot_longer(c(bias, coverage), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(se = if_else(measure == "bias", se_bias, se_cov),
         measure = recode(measure, bias = "Bias (g/kg/day)", coverage = "Coverage of 95% interval"))
fig_pop <- fig_pop |> mutate(method = factor(method, levels = method_levels))
ref <- tibble(measure = c("Bias (g/kg/day)", "Coverage of 95% interval"), y = c(0, 0.95))
p_pop <- ggplot(fig_pop, aes(factor(sd_cp), value, colour = method)) +
  geom_hline(data = ref, aes(yintercept = y), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - 1.96 * se, ymax = value + 1.96 * se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ design, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "SD of participant-specific change-points (g/kg/day)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank())
p_pop
```

# SD of the participant-specific change-points (Model 4)

```{r}
perf_sd <- pop |>
  filter(str_detect(method, "Model 4|Tang")) |>
  group_by(sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method) |>
  summarise(
    n_rep = sum(!is.na(sd_cp_est)),
    mean_posterior_median = mean(sd_cp_est, na.rm = TRUE),
    bias = mean(sd_cp_est - sd_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = if (first(sd_cp) > 0 && str_detect(first(method), "Model 4")) mean(sd_cp_lower <= sd_cp & sd_cp_upper >= sd_cp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    mean_upper = if (str_detect(first(method), "Model 4")) mean(sd_cp_upper, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write_csv(perf_sd, "output/simulation_sd_cp.csv")
perf_sd |>
  mutate(design = scen_lab(n, levels_per_participant)) |>
  select(-n, -levels_per_participant) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "design") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_posterior_median, bias, mean_upper), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = coverage, decimals = 1)
```

Coverage is not reported when the true SD is 0 (boundary of the parameter space).

# Participant-specific change-points

Models 2 and 3 assign the common change-point to every participant.

```{r}
perf_ind <- ind |>
  group_by(sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method) |>
  summarise(
    rmse = sqrt(mean((est - true_cp)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    coverage = mean(lower <= true_cp & upper >= true_cp, na.rm = TRUE),
    width = mean(upper - lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(c(coverage, width), ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
write_csv(perf_ind, "output/simulation_individual.csv")
perf_ind |>
  mutate(design = scen_lab(n, levels_per_participant)) |>
  select(-n, -levels_per_participant) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "design") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(rmse, width), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = coverage, decimals = 1)
```

## By the number of a participant's intake levels below the true change-point (Model 4, SD of change-points > 0)

```{r}
perf_ind_below <- ind |>
  filter(str_detect(method, "Model 4|Tang"), sd_cp > 0) |>
  mutate(levels_below = case_when(n_below_true == 0 ~ "0", n_below_true == 1 ~ "1",
                                  n_below_true == 2 ~ "2", TRUE ~ "3+")) |>
  group_by(method, levels_per_participant, levels_below) |>
  summarise(n_participants = n(),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((est - true_cp)^2)),
            coverage = mean(lower <= true_cp & upper >= true_cp),
            width = mean(upper - lower),
            .groups = "drop")
write_csv(perf_ind_below, "output/simulation_individual_by_levels_below.csv")
perf_ind_below |>
  gt(groupname_col = "method") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(rmse, width), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = coverage, decimals = 1)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 7
p_ind <- perf_ind |>
  mutate(design = scen_lab(n, levels_per_participant)) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(sd_cp), rmse, colour = method, group = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ design, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors, name = NULL) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "SD of participant-specific change-points (g/kg/day)",
       y = "RMSE of participant-specific\nchange-points (g/kg/day)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank())
below_plot <- perf_ind_below |>
  filter(n_participants >= 30) |>
  mutate(design = factor(if_else(levels_per_participant == 7, "7 levels per participant", "4 of 7 levels per participant"),
                         levels = c("7 levels per participant", "4 of 7 levels per participant")))
p_below <- ggplot(below_plot, aes(levels_below, rmse, colour = method, group = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ design, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors, name = NULL) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Intake levels below the participant's true change-point",
       y = "RMSE of participant-specific\nchange-points (g/kg/day)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank())
p_fig4 <- (p_ind / p_below) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.85)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))
p_fig4
```

# Fig 2 of the manuscript

The figures above are for checking. Fig 2 of the manuscript is drawn by `figures/make_fig2_simulation.R`
from the performance measures of the population-level change-point written below; the script can also be
run on its own to adjust the figure.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 6.5
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
perf_pop |>
  select(scenario, sd_cp, n, levels_per_participant, method, n_rep, n_est, bias, mcse_bias, emp_se, rmse,
         coverage, mcse_coverage, width, no_interval) |>
  write_csv("figures/sim_performance_population.csv")
fig2 <- local({
  e <- new.env()
  source("figures/make_fig2_simulation.R", chdir = TRUE, local = e)
  e$fig
})
fig2
```
